SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
      FROM public.canteen_stores s
     WHERE s.id = store_id
       AND s.status = '[literal]'
       AND s.force_closed = false
       AND CASE
             WHEN s.hours_slots IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(s.hours_slots) <> '[literal]' THEN true
             WHEN jsonb_array_length(s.hours_slots) = 0 THEN true
             ELSE EXISTS (
               SELECT 1
                 FROM jsonb_array_elements(s.hours_slots) AS slot
                WHERE CASE
                        WHEN jsonb_typeof(slot->'[literal]') = '[literal]'
                         AND (slot->>'[literal]') ~ '[literal]'
                         AND (slot->>'[literal]') ~ '[literal]'
                        THEN (slot->>'[literal]')::int = EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM (now() AT TIME ZONE '[literal]'))::int
                         AND (now() AT TIME ZONE '[literal]')::time >= (slot->>'[literal]')::time
                         AND (now() AT TIME ZONE '[literal]')::time < (slot->>'[literal]')::time
                        ELSE false
                      END
             )
           END
  )

functions.body: DECLARE v_uid text := auth.uid(); v_kind text := coalesce(nullif(btrim(p_kind), '[literal]'), '[literal]'); v_url text := nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_media_url, '[literal]')), '[literal]'); v_body text := btrim(coalesce(p_body, '[literal]')); v_role text := coalesce(nullif(btrim(p_sender_role), '[literal]'), '[literal]'); v_thread public.chat_threads%ROWTYPE; v_msg public.chat_messages%ROWTYPE; v_name text; v_member boolean := false; BEGIN IF v_uid IS NULL OR public.current_is_anon() THEN RAISE EXCEPTION '[literal]'; END IF; IF v_kind NOT IN ('[literal]', '[literal]') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION '[literal]'; END IF; IF v_kind = '[literal]' THEN IF v_url IS NULL OR v_url !~ '[literal]' OR char_length(v_url) > 1024 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION '[literal]'; END IF; v_body := '[literal]'; ELSE IF v_body = '[literal]' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION '[literal]'; END IF; IF char_length(v_body) > 2000 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION '[literal]'; END IF; v_url := NULL; END IF; SELECT * INTO v_thread FROM public.chat_threads WHERE id = p_thread_id FOR UPDATE; IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION '[literal]'; END IF; IF v_thread.kind <> '[literal]' OR v_thread.college_key IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION '[literal]'; END IF; SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles p WHERE p.uid = v_uid AND p.college = v_thread.college_key ) INTO v_member; IF NOT v_member THEN RAISE EXCEPTION '[literal]'; END IF; SELECT coalesce(nullif(btrim(p.username), '[literal]'), '[literal]') INTO v_name FROM public.profiles p WHERE p.uid = v_uid; v_name := coalesce(v_name, '[literal]'); INSERT INTO public.chat_messages (thread_id, sender_uid, sender_name, sender_role, body, kind, media_url) VALUES (p_thread_id, v_uid, v_name, v_role, v_body, v_kind, v_url) RETURNING * INTO v_msg; UPDATE public.chat_threads SET last_message = v_msg.body, last_sender = v_uid, last_at = v_msg.created_at, updated_at = now() WHERE id = p_thread_id; RETURN jsonb_build_object('[literal]', to_jsonb(v_msg)); END;

functions.body: DECLARE v_uid text := auth.uid(); v_thread public.chat_threads%ROWTYPE; v_is_user boolean; v_was integer := 0; BEGIN IF v_uid IS NULL OR public.current_is_anon() THEN RAISE EXCEPTION '[literal]'; END IF; IF p_thread_id IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION '[literal]'; END IF; SELECT * INTO v_thread FROM public.chat_threads WHERE id = p_thread_id FOR UPDATE; IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION '[literal]'; END IF; IF NOT public.chat_in_thread(p_thread_id) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION '[literal]'; END IF; /* 学院群的未读数按成员各自计算（未实现），这里不碰未读列 */ IF v_thread.kind = '[literal]' THEN RETURN jsonb_build_object('[literal]', to_jsonb(v_thread), '[literal]', 0, '[literal]', 0); END IF; v_is_user := (v_thread.user_uid = v_uid); v_was := CASE WHEN v_is_user THEN v_thread.user_unread ELSE v_thread.peer_unread END; UPDATE public.chat_threads SET user_unread = CASE WHEN v_is_user THEN 0 ELSE user_unread END, peer_unread = CASE WHEN v_is_user THEN peer_unread ELSE 0 END WHERE id = p_thread_id RETURNING * INTO v_thread; RETURN jsonb_build_object( '[literal]', to_jsonb(v_thread), '[literal]', v_was, '[literal]', CASE WHEN v_is_user THEN v_thread.user_unread ELSE v_thread.peer_unread END ); END;

functions.name: chat_messages_page
functions.arguments: p_thread_id bigint, p_limit integer, p_before_id bigint
functions.body: DECLARE v_uid text := auth.uid(); v_limit integer := LEAST(GREATEST(coalesce(p_limit, 30), 1), 100); v_items jsonb := '[literal]'::jsonb; v_page_cnt integer := 0; BEGIN IF v_uid IS NULL OR public.current_is_anon() THEN RAISE EXCEPTION '[literal]'; END IF; IF p_thread_id IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION '[literal]'; END IF; IF NOT public.chat_in_thread(p_thread_id) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION '[literal]'; END IF; WITH page AS ( SELECT m.* FROM public.chat_messages m WHERE m.thread_id = p_thread_id AND (p_before_id IS NULL OR m.id < p_before_id) ORDER BY m.id DESC LIMIT v_limit + 1 ) SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(s.item ORDER BY s.id ASC), '[literal]'::jsonb), (SELECT count(*) FROM page) INTO v_items, v_page_cnt FROM ( SELECT m.id, jsonb_build_object( '[literal]', m.id, '[literal]', m.thread_id, '[literal]', m.sender_uid, '[literal]', m.sender_name, '[literal]', m.sender_role, '[literal]', m.body, '[literal]', coalesce(m.kind, '[literal]'), '[literal]', m.media_url, '[literal]', m.created_at, '[literal]', (m.sender_uid = v_uid) ) AS item FROM page m ORDER BY m.id DESC LIMIT v_limit ) s; RETURN jsonb_build_object( '[literal]', v_items, '[literal]', v_page_cnt > v_limit, '[literal]', CASE WHEN v_page_cnt > v_limit THEN jsonb_build_object('[literal]', v_items -> 0 -> '[literal]') ELSE NULL END ); END;

functions.name: chat_send
functions.arguments: p_thread_id bigint, p_body text, p_sender_role text, p_kind text, p_media_url text
functions.body: DECLARE v_uid text := auth.uid(); v_kind text := coalesce(nullif(btrim(p_kind), '[literal]'), '[literal]'); v_url text := nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_media_url, '[literal]')), '[literal]'); v_body text := btrim(coalesce(p_body, '[literal]')); v_role text := coalesce(nullif(btrim(p_sender_role), '[literal]'), '[literal]'); v_thread public.chat_threads%ROWTYPE; v_msg public.chat_messages%ROWTYPE; v_my_name text; v_is_user boolean; v_is_group boolean; v_peer_restored boolean := false; BEGIN IF v_uid IS NULL OR public.current_is_anon() THEN RAISE EXCEPTION '[literal]'; END IF; IF v_kind NOT IN ('[literal]', '[literal]') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION '[literal]'; END IF; IF v_kind = '[literal]' THEN IF v_url IS NULL OR v_url !~ '[literal]' OR char_length(v_url) > 1024 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION '[literal]'; END IF; v_body := '[literal]'; ELSE IF v_body = '[literal]' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION '[literal]'; END IF; IF char_length(v_body) > 2000 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION '[literal]'; END IF; v_url := NULL; END IF; SELECT * INTO v_thread FROM public.chat_threads WHERE id = p_thread_id FOR UPDATE; IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION '[literal]'; END IF; /* 权限统一走 chat_in_thread()：私信认双方，学院群认 college 匹配。 不要用 `NOT v_is_user AND peer_uid <> v_uid` 这类内联写法 —— 群会话 两列皆 NULL 时判据为 NULL，不抛异常，等于对所有人开放写入。 */ IF NOT public.chat_in_thread(p_thread_id) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION '[literal]'; END IF; v_is_user := (v_thread.user_uid = v_uid); v_is_group := (v_thread.kind = '[literal]'); v_peer_restored := CASE WHEN v_is_group THEN false WHEN v_is_user THEN v_thread.peer_hidden_at IS NOT NULL ELSE v_thread.user_hidden_at IS NOT NULL END; SELECT coalesce(nullif(btrim(p.username), '[literal]'), '[literal]') INTO v_my_name FROM public.profiles p WHERE p.uid = v_uid; v_my_name := coalesce(v_my_name, '[literal]'); INSERT INTO public.chat_messages (thread_id, sender_uid, sender_name, sender_role, body, kind, media_url) VALUES (p_thread_id, v_uid, v_my_name, v_role, v_body, v_kind, v_url) RETURNING * INTO v_msg; /* 学院群没有「双方」：不累加未读、不动隐藏标记，只更新最后一条摘要 */ UPDATE public.chat_threads SET last_message = v_msg.body, last_sender = v_uid, last_at = v_msg.created_at, user_unread = CASE WHEN v_is_group OR v_is_user THEN user_unread ELSE GREATEST(user_unread + 1, 0) END, peer_unread = CASE WHEN v_is_group THEN peer_unread WHEN v_is_user THEN GREATEST(peer_unread + 1, 0) ELSE peer_unread END, user_hidden_at = CASE WHEN v_is_group THEN user_hidden_at WHEN v_is_user THEN user_hidden_at ELSE NULL END, peer_hidden_at = CASE WHEN v_is_group THEN peer_hidden_at WHEN v_is_user THEN NULL ELSE peer_hidden_at END, updated_at = now() WHERE id = p_thread_id RETURNING * INTO v_thread; RETURN jsonb_build_object( '[literal]', to_jsonb(v_msg), '[literal]', to_jsonb(v_thread), '[literal]', v_peer_restored ); END;

functions.name: chat_thread_hide
chat_thread_list
functions.arguments: p_limit integer, p_before_at timestamp with time zone, p_before_id bigint
functions.body:
DECLARE
  v_uid       text := auth.uid();
  v_limit     integer := LEAST(GREATEST(coalesce(p_limit, 30), 1), 100);
  v_before_id bigint := coalesce(p_before_id, 0);
  v_items     jsonb := '[literal]'::jsonb;
  v_page_cnt  integer := 0;
  v_total     integer := 0;
  v_unread    integer := 0;
  v_has_more  boolean := false;
  v_next      jsonb := NULL;
BEGIN
  IF v_uid IS NULL OR public.current_is_anon() THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION '[literal]';
  END IF;

  -- 可见会话总数 + 我的未读总数：口径与列表严格一致（隐藏的会话不计入，
  -- 又因为新消息会清掉隐藏，不会留下「看不见的未读」长期挂账）
  SELECT count(*),
         coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN t.user_uid = v_uid THEN t.user_unread ELSE t.peer_unread END), 0)
    INTO v_total, v_unread
    FROM public.chat_threads t
   WHERE (t.user_uid = v_uid AND t.user_hidden_at IS NULL)
      OR (t.peer_uid = v_uid AND t.peer_hidden_at IS NULL);

  WITH box AS (
    SELECT t.*
      FROM public.chat_threads t
     WHERE t.user_uid = v_uid
       AND t.user_hidden_at IS NULL
       AND (p_before_at IS NULL OR (t.last_at, t.id) < (p_before_at, v_before_id))
    UNION ALL
    SELECT t.*
      FROM public.chat_threads t
     WHERE t.peer_uid = v_uid
       AND t.peer_hidden_at IS NULL
       AND (p_before_at IS NULL OR (t.last_at, t.id) < (p_before_at, v_before_id))
  ),
  page AS (
    SELECT b.*
      FROM box b
     ORDER BY b.last_at DESC, b.id DESC
     LIMIT v_limit + 1
  )
  SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(s.item ORDER BY s.last_at DESC, s.id DESC), '[literal]'::jsonb),
         (SELECT count(*) FROM page)
    INTO v_items, v_page_cnt
    FROM (
      SELECT b.last_at,
             b.id,
             jsonb_build_object(
               '[literal]',               b.id,
               '[literal]',       b.topic_type,
               '[literal]',         b.topic_id,
               '[literal]',      b.topic_title,
               '[literal]',         b.user_uid,
               '[literal]',        b.user_name,
               '[literal]',         b.peer_uid,
               '[literal]',        b.peer_name,
               '[literal]',        b.peer_role,
               '[literal]',     b.last_message,
               '[literal]',      b.last_sender,
               '[literal]',          b.last_at,
               '[literal]',       b.created_at,
               '[literal]',      b.user_unread,
               '[literal]',      b.peer_unread,
               '[literal]',        (b.user_uid = v_uid),
               '[literal]',        CASE WHEN b.user_uid = v_uid THEN b.user_unread ELSE b.peer_unread END,
               '[literal]',        CASE WHEN b.user_uid = v_uid THEN b.peer_uid ELSE b.user_uid END,
               '[literal]',       CASE WHEN b.user_uid = v_uid THEN b.peer_name ELSE b.user_name END,
               '[literal]',       CASE WHEN b.user_uid = v_uid THEN b.peer_role ELSE '[literal]' END,
               '[literal]', (b.last_sender = v_uid)
             ) AS item
        FROM page b
       ORDER BY b.last_at DESC, b.id DESC
       LIMIT v_limit
    ) s;

  v_has_more := v_page_cnt > v_limit;
  IF v_has_more THEN
    -- items 按 last_at DESC 排序，最后一条就是本页最旧的一条，作为下一页游标
    v_next := jsonb_build_object(
      '[literal]', v_items -> -1 -> '[literal]',
      '[literal]', v_items -> -1 -> '[literal]'
    );
  END IF;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    '[literal]',        v_items,
    '[literal]',        v_total,
    '[literal]', v_unread,
    '[literal]',     v_has_more,
    '[literal]',  v_next
  );
END;

functions.arguments: p_scope text, p_actor text, p_limit integer, p_window_seconds integer
functions.body: declare v_window integer := coalesce(p_window_seconds, 60); v_caller text; v_key text; v_start timestamptz; v_reset timestamptz; v_hits integer; begin if p_scope is null or btrim(p_scope) = '[literal]' or p_actor is null or btrim(p_actor) = '[literal]' then raise exception '[literal]'; end if; if v_window < 1 or v_window > 86400 then raise exception '[literal]'; end if; /* 防绕过：客户端若拿登录态直接调本 RPC，计数键强制绑到调用者自己身上， 这样最多只能耗尽自己的配额，刷不到别人。 云函数用 accessKey 调用时 auth.uid() 为空，键仍按调用方传入的 p_actor 走。 */ v_caller := auth.uid(); v_key := case when v_caller is null then p_actor else '[literal]' || v_caller end; v_start := to_timestamp(floor(extract(epoch from now()) / v_window) * v_window); v_reset := v_start + make_interval(secs => v_window); insert into public.function_rate_limits(scope, actor, window_start, hits, updated_at) values (p_scope, v_key, v_start, 1, now()) on conflict (scope, actor, window_start) do update set hits = public.function_rate_limits.hits + 1, updated_at = now() returning public.function_rate_limits.hits into v_hits; if random() < 0.01 then delete from public.function_rate_limits where window_start < now() - make_interval(secs => v_window * 10); end if; if v_hits > p_limit then return jsonb_build_object('[literal]', false, '[literal]', 0, '[literal]', greatest(1, ceil(extract(epoch from (v_reset - now()))))::int, '[literal]', p_limit); end if; return jsonb_build_object('[literal]', true, '[literal]', greatest(0, p_limit - v_hits), '[literal]', 0, '[literal]', p_limit); end;

functions.name: todo_remind_scan
functions.body:
DECLARE
  v_uid     text := auth.uid();
  v_ahead   integer := GREATEST(15, LEAST(COALESCE(p_ahead_minutes, 120), 24 * 60));
  v_today   date := (now() AT TIME ZONE '[literal]')::date;
  v_due     jsonb := '[literal]'::jsonb;
  v_created integer := 0;
  v_today_n integer := 0;
  v_overdue integer := 0;
BEGIN
  IF v_uid IS NULL OR public.current_is_anon() THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION '[literal]';
  END IF;

  -- 临期清单：到期前 v_ahead 分钟内，或已逾期 7 天内（更早的不再打扰）
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(t.x ORDER BY t.due), '[literal]'::jsonb)
    INTO v_due
    FROM (
      SELECT jsonb_build_object('[literal]', td.id, '[literal]', td.title, '[literal]', td.due_at) AS x,
             td.due_at AS due
        FROM public.todos td
       WHERE td.uid = v_uid
         AND td.done = false
         AND td.due_at IS NOT NULL
         AND td.due_at <= now() + (v_ahead || '[literal]')::interval
         AND td.due_at >= now() - interval '[literal]'
    ) t;

  -- 每条待办每天至多一条提醒，去重后写入通知中心
  INSERT INTO public.notifications (uid, kind, title, body, link, ref_id)
  SELECT v_uid, '[literal]', '[literal]',
         CASE
           WHEN td.due_at < now() THEN format('[literal]', td.title)
           ELSE format('[literal]', td.title)
         END,
         '[literal]', td.id
    FROM public.todos td
   WHERE td.uid = v_uid
     AND td.done = false
     AND td.due_at IS NOT NULL
     AND td.due_at <= now() + (v_ahead || '[literal]')::interval
     AND td.due_at >= now() - interval '[literal]'
     AND NOT EXISTS (
       SELECT 1 FROM public.notifications n
        WHERE n.uid = v_uid
          AND n.kind = '[literal]'
          AND n.ref_id = td.id
          AND (n.created_at AT TIME ZONE '[literal]')::date = v_today
     );
  GET DIAGNOSTICS v_created = ROW_COUNT;

  SELECT count(*) INTO v_today_n
    FROM public.todos
   WHERE uid = v_uid AND done = false
     AND due_at IS NOT NULL
     AND (due_at AT TIME ZONE '[literal]')::date = v_today;

  SELECT count(*) INTO v_overdue
    FROM public.todos
   WHERE uid = v_uid AND done = false
     AND due_at IS NOT NULL
     AND due_at < now();

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    '[literal]', v_due,
    '[literal]', v_created,
    '[literal]', v_today_n,
    '[literal]', v_overdue,
    '[literal]', NULL
  );
END;

functions.name: toggle_post_like
functions.body: DECLARE v_uid text := auth.uid()::text; v_liked boolean := false; BEGIN IF v_uid IS NULL OR v_uid = '[literal]' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION '[literal]'; END IF; IF pid IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION '[literal]'; END IF; SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.plaza_post_likes WHERE post_id = pid AND uid = v_uid) INTO v_liked; IF v_liked THEN DELETE FROM public.plaza_post_likes WHERE post_id = pid AND uid = v_uid; UPDATE public.plaza_posts SET likes = GREATEST(0, likes - 1) WHERE id = pid; ELSE INSERT INTO public.plaza_post_likes (post_id, uid) VALUES (pid, v_uid) ON CONFLICT (post_id, uid) DO NOTHING; UPDATE public.plaza_posts SET likes = likes + 1 WHERE id = pid; END IF; RETURN jsonb_build_object( '[literal]', true, '[literal]', NOT v_liked, '[literal]', (SELECT likes FROM public.plaza_posts WHERE id = pid) ); END;

views.name: v_cat_charity_public
views.definition:
SELECT ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM pet_cat_wallets) AS participants,
    ( SELECT COALESCE(sum(pet_cat_wallets.earned_total), 0::bigint) AS "coalesce"
           FROM pet_cat_wallets) AS earned_total,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM pet_cat_exchanges x
             JOIN cat_charity_items i ON i.key = x.item_key
          WHERE i.kind = 'feed'::text) AS feed_count,
    (( SELECT COALESCE(sum(x.points_cost), 0::bigint) AS "coalesce"
           FROM pet_cat_exchanges x
             JOIN cat_charity_items i ON i.key = x.item_key
          WHERE i.kind = 'fund'::text)) + (( SELECT COALESCE(sum(m.awarded), 0::bigint) AS "coalesce"
           FROM pet_cat_milestones m)) AS fund_points,
    ( SELECT COALESCE(sum(m.awarded), 0::bigint) AS "coalesce"
           FROM pet_cat_milestones m) AS milestone_fund,
    100000::bigint AS milestone_step,
    ((( SELECT COALESCE(sum(pet_cat_wallets.earned_total), 0::bigint) AS "coalesce"
           FROM pet_cat_wallets)) / 100000 + 1) * 100000 AS milestone_next;
